subtitles: [{"id":1,"startTime":0,"endTime":19,"speaker":"Operator","speakerType":"operator","en":"Good afternoon, everyone, and welcome to Nike, Inc.'s first quarter fiscal 2027 conference call. For those who want to reference today's press release, you'll find it at investors.nike.com. Leading today's call is Paul Trussell, VP of Corporate Finance and Treasurer. I'd now like to turn the call over to Paul Trussell.","zh":"大家下午好，欢迎参加 Nike, Inc. 2027 财年第一季度电话会议。对于那些想要参考今天的新闻稿的人，您可以在 Investors.nike.com 上找到它。今天的电话会议由企业财务副总裁兼财务主管 Paul Trussel 主持。我现在想把电话转给保罗·特鲁塞尔。"},{"id":2,"startTime":19,"endTime":87,"speaker":"Paul Trussell","speakerType":"management","en":"Thank you, Operator. Hello, everyone, and thank you for joining us today to discuss Nike, Inc.'s first quarter fiscal 2027 results. Joining us on today's call will be Nike, Inc. President and CEO Elliott Hill and CFO Dave Denton. Before we begin, let me remind you that participants on this call will make forward-looking statements based on current expectations, and those statements are subject to certain risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially. These risks and uncertainties are detailed in Nike's reports filed with the SEC. In addition, participants may discuss non-GAAP financial measures and non-public financial and statistical information. Please refer to Nike's earnings press release or Nike's website, investors.nike.com, for comparable GAAP measures and quantitative reconciliations. All growth comparisons on the call today are presented on a year-over-year basis and are currency neutral unless otherwise noted.","zh":"谢谢你，接线员。大家好，感谢您今天加入我们讨论 Nike, Inc. 2027 财年第一季度的业绩。耐克公司总裁兼首席执行官埃利奥特·希尔 (Elliott Hill) 和首席财务官戴夫·丹顿 (Dave Denton) 将参加今天的电话会议。在我们开始之前，请允许我提醒您，本次电话会议的参与者将根据当前的预期做出前瞻性声明，这些声明受到某些风险和不确定性的影响，可能导致实际结果出现重大差异。耐克向美国证券交易委员会提交的报告详细介绍了这些风险和不确定性。此外，参与者还可以讨论非公认会计准则财务指标以及非公开财务和统计信息。请参阅耐克的收益新闻稿或耐克的网站 Investors.nike.com，了解可比的 GAAP 衡量标准和定量调节表。除非另有说明，今天电话会议上的所有增长比较都是按年计算的，并且是货币中性的。"},{"id":3,"startTime":87,"endTime":110,"speaker":"Paul Trussell","speakerType":"management","en":"We will start with prepared remarks and then open the call for questions. We would like to allow as many of you to ask questions as possible in our allotted time, so we'd appreciate you limiting your initial question to one. Thank you for your cooperation on this. I'll now turn the call over to Nike, Inc. President and CEO Elliott Hill.","zh":"我们将从准备好的发言开始，然后开始提问。我们希望让尽可能多的人在我们分配的时间内提出问题，因此我们希望您将最初的问题限制为一个。感谢您对此的配合。我现在将把电话转给耐克公司总裁兼首席执行官埃利奥特·希尔 (Elliott Hill)。"},{"id":4,"startTime":110,"endTime":183,"speaker":"Elliott Hill","speakerType":"management","en":"Before I begin, I want to welcome Dave Denton to Nike. Dave brings deep financial expertise, strong operational leadership, and a proven track record of helping world-class companies grow. I'm excited to partner with him and the rest of our senior leadership team to serve consumers better, accelerate our profitability, and create long-term value for shareholders. For the first quarter, results were in line with our expectations. Nike, Inc. revenue was within the range we guided to. Gross margin improved, as we said it would, and we managed costs with discipline. Importantly, the quarter showed the sport offense is driving results. Our Nike brand performance portfolio continued to grow. Last fiscal year, we grew this business to $16 billion. We built on that foundation this quarter, growing Nike performance by another high single digits. Today, I'll share more about the momentum we're seeing across our key sports.","zh":"在开始之前，我想欢迎戴夫·丹顿加入耐克。戴夫带来了深厚的财务专业知识、强大的运营领导能力以及帮助世界一流公司成长的良好记录。我很高兴与他和我们高级领导团队的其他成员合作，更好地服务消费者，加速我们的盈利，并为股东创造长期价值。第一季度的业绩符合我们的预期。耐克公司的收入处于我们指导的范围内。正如我们所说，毛利率有所改善，而且我们严格控制成本。重要的是，本季度表明体育进攻正在推动业绩。我们的耐克品牌业绩组合持续增长。上一财年，我们的业务增长至 160 亿美元。本季度，我们在此基础上再接再厉，耐克的业绩又实现了高个位数的增长。今天，我将更多地分享我们在主要体育项目中看到的势头。"},{"id":5,"startTime":183,"endTime":254,"speaker":"Elliott Hill","speakerType":"management","en":"Despite that progress, our Nike performance business is not yet large enough to offset the pressure we're seeing in Nike Sportswear, Jordan Brand, and Greater China. We're taking deliberate actions to strengthen those businesses, but realizing the full benefit of those efforts will take time. On the call, I'll provide more detail on what we're doing and why. And finally, Dave and I will share how we're transforming Nike's operating model to scale the success of the sport offense across the company. This work has been underway for some time, and it's an important part of building Nike the right way for the long term. Let me start with Nike Sportswear, Jordan Brand, and Greater China. We've identified the areas that need improvement and are actively repositioning these important businesses. Nike Sportswear, which accounted for just under half of this quarter's revenue, was down low double digits.","zh":"尽管取得了这些进展，但我们的耐克运动鞋业务还不足以抵消我们在耐克运动服装、乔丹品牌和大中华区看到的压力。我们正在采取深思熟虑的行动来加强这些业务，但实现这些努力的全部效益需要时间。在电话会议上，我将提供有关我们正在做什么以及原因的更多详细信息。最后，戴夫和我将分享我们如何转变耐克的运营模式，以扩大整个公司体育进攻的成功。这项工作已经进行了一段时间，它是耐克长期正确发展道路的重要组成部分。让我从 Nike Sportswear、Jordan Brand 和大中华区开始。我们已经确定了需要改进的领域，并正在积极重新定位这些重要业务。占本季度收入近一半的耐克运动服装业务出现低两位数下滑。"},{"id":6,"startTime":254,"endTime":333,"speaker":"Elliott Hill","speakerType":"management","en":"The decline reflected a combination of deliberate actions, product underperformance, and broader marketplace pressure. The first factor was one we expected. As planned, we reduced revenue from the Dunk by nearly 50% in the quarter. That resulted in roughly $200 million headwind in sportswear. In addition, some aged higher volume sportswear footwear sold through below expectations. Looking ahead, that has impacted our future order books as we proactively work with our wholesale partners to work through excess inventory to create a healthy marketplace. Overall, there's a lack of energy in the lifestyle space right now, which is impacting traffic. Yes, the consumer is cautious. But as the leader in the industry, it's on us to bring more creativity to sportswear. The headline decline only tells part of the story. Within sportswear, several major franchises are healthy and growing.","zh":"这种下降反映了故意行动、产品表现不佳和更广泛的市场压力的综合作用。第一个因素是我们预期的。按照计划，我们本季度 Dunk 的收入减少了近 50%。这导致运动装领域遭受了约 2 亿美元的不利影响。此外，一些销量较大的旧运动鞋类的销量也低于预期。展望未来，这会影响我们未来的订单，因为我们积极与批发合作伙伴合作，通过过剩库存来创建一个健康的市场。总体而言，目前生活方式领域缺乏活力，这正在影响交通。是的，消费者是谨慎的。但作为行业的领导者，我们有责任为运动服装带来更多创意。总体下降仅说明了故事的一部分。在运动服装领域，几家主要的核心产品系列都健康成长。"},{"id":7,"startTime":333,"endTime":411,"speaker":"Elliott Hill","speakerType":"management","en":"The Air Force One, one of the most important sneakers in the world, is now driving a stable full-price business through new dimensions and seasonal materials and colors. We also have a handful of sportswear footwear franchises that have scaled over several seasons that grew by strong double digits in this quarter, led by our running-inspired silhouettes, the P-6000 and the V5 RNR. And where we have introduced newness at scale, we've seen early success. We launched Studio Fleece for women and Solo Fleece for men during back-to-school season, and the Studio Fleece was the best performing apparel collection of the quarter in all of Nike, Inc. The common thread across these successful franchises is clarity. They know exactly who they are serving. That's the lesson. The sportswear consumer isn't one audience. It's a collection of consumers with distinct needs, tastes, and motivations.","zh":"空军一号是世界上最重要的运动鞋之一，现在通过新的尺寸和季节性材料和颜色推动了稳定的全价业务。我们还有一些运动服装鞋类产品系列，这些产品系列已经在几个季度中扩大规模，在本季度实现了两位数的强劲增长，其中以我们的跑步鞋款 P-6000 和 V5 RNR 为首。在我们大规模引入新鲜事物的地方，我们已经看到了早期的成功。我们在返校季推出了女式 Studio Fleece 和男式 Solo Fleece，Studio Fleece 是 Nike, Inc. 本季度表现最好的服装系列。这些成功系列的共同点是清晰。他们清楚地知道自己在为谁服务。这就是教训。运动服消费者并不是其中之一。它是具有不同需求、品味和动机的消费者的集合。"},{"id":8,"startTime":411,"endTime":489,"speaker":"Elliott Hill","speakerType":"management","en":"We're organizing sportswear assortments the same way we've organized our performance business, around specific consumer insights and distinct style preferences. We're breaking down the sportswear business into smaller areas of focus to create a more diverse product portfolio and a more differentiated marketplace. We'll see less of a sea of sameness that's hurting the lifestyle marketplace across our brands and our competitors right now. That's how we believe we'll move from managing a few successful sportswear franchises to building a deep bench of winners across the entire marketplace. With Jordan Brand footwear, we're going to get back to leading the scarcity model that we created. Simply put, we've been oversupplying our iconic retro product, asking them to do too much. As we've done with the Air Jordan One, we will deliberately reduce the volume and frequency of specific Jordan retro launches. We've discussed it with our wholesale partners.","zh":"我们围绕特定的消费者洞察和独特的风格偏好，以与组织运动服装业务相同的方式组织运动装品种。我们正在将运动服装业务分解为更小的重点领域，以创建更多样化的产品组合和更具差异化的市场。我们现在将看到更少的千篇一律的行为损害我们的品牌和竞争对手的生活方式市场。这就是我们相信我们将从管理一些成功的运动服装产品系列转向在整个市场建立一批获胜者的方式。凭借 Jordan Brand 鞋类，我们将重新引领我们创造的稀缺模式。简而言之，我们一直在供应过剩的标志性复古产品，要求他们做太多事情。正如我们对 Air Jordan One 所做的那样，我们将刻意减少特定 Jordan 复古款的发布数量和频率。我们已经与我们的批发合作伙伴讨论过。"},{"id":9,"startTime":489,"endTime":561,"speaker":"Elliott Hill","speakerType":"management","en":"Together, we will restore balance to the marketplace to create a foundation for more profitable and sustainable growth. In the near term, North America will feel the biggest impact. To give you a better sense of the scale of these actions, in Q1, the Jordan Brand represented 13% of our global business, with revenue falling by mid-teens. Here's why we're doing this. When consumers see the Jumpman, it should feel special. It should feel earned. Every decision we're making is designed to ensure the Jordan Brand remains as coveted a decade from now as it has been for the past several decades. Let's turn to Greater China, where for the quarter, revenue declined 26%. With a new leadership team in place for the past six months, we have been moving with urgency to alter the landscape and improve our position in the marketplace.","zh":"我们将共同恢复市场平衡，为实现更高利润和可持续增长奠定基础。短期内，北美将受到最大的影响。为了让您更好地了解这些行动的规模，第一季度，Jordan 品牌占我们全球业务的 13%，收入下降了 15%。这就是我们这样做的原因。当消费者看到Jumpman时，应该会感到很特别。应该有一种赚到的感觉。我们所做的每一个决定都是为了确保 Jordan 品牌在十年后仍然像过去几十年一样令人垂涎。让我们看看大中华区，该季度的收入下降了 26%。随着过去六个月新领导团队的就位，我们一直在紧急行动，以改变格局并提高我们在市场中的地位。"},{"id":10,"startTime":561,"endTime":639,"speaker":"Elliott Hill","speakerType":"management","en":"As we announced in July, we are activating a plan to clean up the digital side of this market. We are eliminating distribution through channels that are not aligned with our marketplace strategy, which will decrease the deep discounting of our brands. We will anchor Nike's and Jordan's digital marketplace in China around fewer, higher quality experiences through the official Nike flagship storefronts on Tmall, JD, and Douyin, alongside nike.com and the Nike app. We believe a tightened digital ecosystem of Nike flagships will enable a more premium brand presentation with clearer product stories and a more connected consumer journey. The focus will allow our top partners to concentrate on creating inspirational brick-and-mortar retail experiences. The majority of our partners' physical doors in Greater China have not been refreshed in the past seven years. When we elevate retail experience and lead with sport, we see results.","zh":"正如我们在 7 月份宣布的那样，我们正在启动一项清理该市场数字方面的计划。我们正在消除与我们的市场策略不相符的渠道的分销，这将减少我们品牌的大幅折扣。我们将通过天猫、京东和抖音上的耐克官方旗舰店以及 nike.com 和耐克应用程序，围绕更少、更高质量的体验来锚定耐克和乔丹在中国的数字渠道生态。我们相信，耐克旗舰店的更紧密的数字零售生态将通过更清晰的产品故事和更互联的消费者旅程实现更优质的品牌展示。这一重点将使我们的顶级合作伙伴能够专注于创造鼓舞人心的实体零售体验。我们在大中华区的大多数合作伙伴的实体门在过去七年中都没有刷新过。当我们提升零售体验并以体育为主导时，我们就会看到成果。"},{"id":11,"startTime":639,"endTime":720,"speaker":"Elliott Hill","speakerType":"management","en":"In Shanghai, our House of Innovation has delivered 10 consecutive months of growth since making that shift. In the near term, revenues and profitability in China will be impacted. We expect our digital cleanup to take multiple seasons as we continue to take targeted actions with our partners to improve inventory levels. Taken together, Sportswear, Jordan Brand, and Greater China represent significant work ahead. But we know what healthy looks like, and we're taking deliberate actions to get there. These challenges are significant, but they are not the whole story at Nike. At the same time, the sport offense is delivering measurable progress against our performance portfolio. Here's what that looked like this quarter. Running is up double digits again with consistent share gains. Global Football benefited from World Cup energy to drive strong double-digit growth in all four geos. Training grew globally, led by EMEA.","zh":"在上海，我们的创新之家自进行转变以来已连续 10 个月实现增长。短期内，中国的收入和盈利能力将受到影响。我们预计数字清理工作将需要多个季节，因为我们将继续与合作伙伴采取有针对性的行动来提高库存水平。总而言之，运动服饰、Jordan Brand 和大中华区代表了未来的重大工作。但我们知道健康是什么样子，并且我们正在采取刻意的行动来实现这一目标。这些挑战是重大的，但它们并不是耐克的全部。与此同时，运动进攻在我们的表现组合中取得了可衡量的进步。这是本季度的情况。跑步率再次增长两位数，份额持续增长。全球足球受益于世界杯的能量，推动所有四个地区实现两位数的强劲增长。在欧洲、中东和非洲地区的带动下，培训在全球范围内不断增长。"},{"id":12,"startTime":720,"endTime":796,"speaker":"Elliott Hill","speakerType":"management","en":"Basketball was up double digits in North America, with expectation that the sport will continue its momentum in Q2. Both Tennis and Golf grew double digits. In Nike Running, our innovation in max cushioning helped reignite this business. Led by the strength of the Vomero franchise, we've nearly tripled our share of the max cushioning category over the past year. Now we're entering the next phase of Nike Running. Over the past two months, we've introduced four new footwear innovations, three in our racing silo and one in our Pegasus silo, each built around a different runner, a distance, and a goal. In August, we launched the Pegasus Plus Two, a fast tempo training shoe with a curved Air Zoom unit for a quick, smooth ride. In September, we unveiled the Alphafly Four, a lighter, more energy-giving version of our most celebrated marathon shoe.","zh":"篮球在北美的销量增长了两位数，预计这项运动将在第二季度继续保持势头。网球和高尔夫均实现两位数增长。在 Nike Running 中，我们在最大缓震方面的创新帮助重新点燃了这一业务。在 Vomero 产品系列的带领下，去年我们在最大缓冲类别中的份额几乎增加了两倍。现在我们正在进入 Nike Running 的下一阶段。在过去的两个月里，我们推出了四款新的鞋类创新产品，其中三款是在我们的赛车系列中，一款是在我们的 Pegasus 系列中，每一款都围绕不同的跑步者、距离和目标而设计。八月，我们推出了 Pegasus Plus Two，这是一款快节奏训练鞋，配有弧形 Air Zoom 装置，可实现快速、平稳的骑行。九月，我们推出了 Alphafly Four，这是我们最著名的马拉松鞋的更轻、更能量的版本。"},{"id":13,"startTime":796,"endTime":877,"speaker":"Elliott Hill","speakerType":"management","en":"Yesterday, we introduced two new shoes that span the spectrum of runners. The Swooshfly, our entry-level marathon racing shoe designed for the four-hour-plus runner. Nike Apex, a super shoe with double-stacked Air Zoom units that deliver an incredible 40% more energy than the Alphafly Three. In global football, we are pleased with our World Cup results as we doubled our World Cup team kits sales compared to the 2022 tournament. One of our strategies going into the tournament was to use the energy to invest in a much needed refresh of the global football marketplace. This quarter, the newly elevated marketplace helped drive stronger sales in our club football kits this quarter, which was up high teens. That is critical because club football fans buy season after season. Training is one of Nike's largest untapped performance opportunities because every athlete trains. We are seeing success across the portfolio.","zh":"昨天，我们推出了两款涵盖跑步者范围的新鞋。 Swooshfly 是我们的入门级马拉松跑鞋，专为四个小时以上的跑步者设计。 Nike Apex 是一款配备双层 Air Zoom 单元的超级鞋，其能量比 Alphafly 3 多出令人难以置信的 40%。在全球足球领域，我们对世界杯的成绩感到满意，与 2022 年世界杯相比，我们的世界杯球队球衣销量翻了一番。我们进入世界杯的策略之一是利用这些精力来投资全球足球市场急需的更新。本季度，新提升的市场帮助推动了我们俱乐部足球装备的销售强劲，销售额增长了十几岁。这一点至关重要，因为俱乐部球迷会一季又一季地购买。训练是耐克最大的未开发的表现机会之一，因为每个运动员都会训练。我们看到整个产品组合都取得了成功。"},{"id":14,"startTime":877,"endTime":953,"speaker":"Elliott Hill","speakerType":"management","en":"Nike Mind has quickly become one of our top-selling franchises. Nike Pro and Metcon are industry icons, and we just introduced the Nike Hybrid Footwear system for both running and strength movements to serve the fast-growing world of hybrid training and racing. The new Hyperslide brings the next recovery innovation from our Nike Hyperice partnership to a more accessible price point. In basketball, where we are the global leaders, one of our most powerful growth opportunities is the women's game. Nike Basketball has grown our women's signature business nearly 500% from FY 2022 to FY 2026. Today, we activated the largest women's signature shoe launch in Nike's history, the Caitlin one. It will launch in 5,000 doors, twice the average for a Nike Basketball signature shoe, supported by our largest Nike product campaign for the holiday season. What we have learned through the sport offense is that focus wins.","zh":"Nike Mind 已迅速成为我们最畅销的产品系列之一。 Nike Pro 和 Metcon 是行业标志，我们刚刚推出了适用于跑步和力量运动的 Nike Hybrid Footwear 系统，为快速发展的混合训练和赛车领域提供服务。新款 Hyperslide 将我们与 Nike Hyperice 合作伙伴的下一个恢复创新技术带到了更实惠的价格点。在篮球领域，我们是全球领先者，我们最强大的增长机会之一就是女子比赛。从 2022 财年到 2026 财年，耐克篮球的女子球星签名鞋业务增长了近 500%。今天，我们启动了耐克历史上规模最大的女子球星专属签名鞋——Caitlin 1 的发布。在我们假日季最大规模的耐克产品活动的支持下，它将在 5,000 家门店发售，铺货门店数是耐克篮球球星签名鞋平均水平的两倍。我们从运动进攻中学到的是，专注获胜。"},{"id":15,"startTime":953,"endTime":1024,"speaker":"Elliott Hill","speakerType":"management","en":"When teams get closer to the athlete, the consumer, and the marketplace, they make better decisions. Over the past year, we have taken steps to make certain that the rest of the company can move at the same speed. That is the thinking behind Pace, a program that brings several operational changes together under one effort. The purpose of Pace is clear. Accelerate the sport offense. It will change how and where we work, move decisions and roles closer to the consumer, and build capabilities that will allow us to move faster. The sport offense is proving itself. Pace is how we scale it. The first element is the work that is already underway to evolve our supply chain from a mostly fixed structure to one that is more flexible, responsive, and cost-effective. Under Elliott's tenure, it is clear we have made significant strides toward these objectives, but we still have more work to do.","zh":"我的职责的一个关键部分是确保我们的运动鞋业务长期可持续增长并实现盈利，同时还致力于让运动服装以及我们的 Jordan 和 Converse 品牌恢复财务健康。这意味着确保我们为我们的优先事项提供适当的资源，严格遵守纪律并紧迫地采取正确的行动，并在整个组织内保持问责制。我们将继续坚定不移地致力于推动股东价值，这要求我们将耐克投资组合品牌恢复到优质地位，通过提高生产力和更好的工作方式提高公司的营业利润率，有目的地投资以推动更高质量的营收业绩并释放新的增长机会，并适当分配资本以最大限度地创造股东价值。在埃利奥特的任期内，我们显然在实现这些目标方面取得了重大进展，但我们仍有更多工作要做。"},{"id":20,"startTime":1276,"endTime":1336,"speaker":"Dave Denton","speakerType":"management","en":"Our results are below both our expectations and our potential, and we are focused on closing this gap.
